incident_text: Replies feel slow since about 09:40 UTC (users say 'the bot takes ages'). No errors reported.

changes.title: feat: include the last 20 turns of history in the prompt
changes.author: meera

edits.replace:
ctx = json.loads(raw) if raw else {"turns": []}
    ctx["turns"] = ctx["turns"][-20:]

truth.description: The LLM provider became about 3x slower; with the gateway's telemetry export broken and worker traces off, it cannot be told apart from the prompt-history deploy a minute earlier.

trap: Worker duration rises right after a deploy that makes prompts longer; the gateway's metrics and logs and the worker's traces are missing, so provider slowness and the deploy cannot be separated. INCONCLUSIVE is correct.
